outcomes.title: Essential services infrastructure restored
outcomes.description: Critical infrastructure that supports essential services including power, water, sewerage, telecommunications, and transport has been repaired or rebuilt to restore reliable service delivery to the affected community.

activities.title: Prioritise restoration of essential utility services
activities.description: Implement prioritised repair programs for essential utility infrastructure including electricity, water supply, sewerage, and gas networks based on community need and safety risk assessments.

activities.title: Restore telecommunications and digital connectivity
activities.description: Repair and rebuild telecommunications infrastructure including mobile towers, fixed-line networks, and broadband services to restore digital connectivity critical for community functioning and recovery coordination.

activities.title: Rebuild critical transport links and routes
activities.description: Repair damaged roads, bridges, rail lines, and other transport infrastructure to restore safe and reliable access for communities, emergency services, and supply chains.

activities.title: Establish temporary service arrangements during rebuilding
activities.description: Deploy temporary infrastructure solutions such as portable generators, water tanks, temporary bridges, and mobile telecommunications to maintain essential service levels while permanent repairs are underway.

indicators.title: Essential infrastructure operational status
indicators.description: Percentage of essential service infrastructure restored to full operational capacity, tracked by infrastructure type and geographic area.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Infrastructure restoration tracking register maintained by coordinating agencies, with weekly status updates from utility providers and infrastructure owners.

indicators.title: Service reliability and quality metrics
indicators.description: Reliability and quality of essential services delivered to the community including power outage frequency, water quality compliance, and road network accessibility.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Utility service performance data collected from infrastructure operators on a monthly basis, benchmarked against pre-disaster service levels and regulatory standards.

indicators.title: Community satisfaction with essential services restoration
indicators.description: Community members' satisfaction with the restoration of essential services including perceived reliability, quality, and timeliness of repair.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Community satisfaction survey administered quarterly, covering all essential service categories with questions on reliability, quality, and adequacy of service delivery.

indicators.title: Remaining service disruptions and workarounds
indicators.description: Number and nature of ongoing essential service disruptions and temporary arrangements still in place, with estimated timelines for permanent restoration.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Service disruption register maintained by recovery coordination centre, updated fortnightly with data from all essential service providers and local government.

outcomes.title: Community infrastructure restored and improved
outcomes.description: Public and community infrastructure including schools, hospitals, community centres, libraries, parks, and recreational facilities has been repaired, rebuilt, or replaced, enabling communities to resume normal activities and access services.

activities.title: Develop prioritised community infrastructure rebuild program
activities.description: Assess damaged community infrastructure, prioritise rebuilding based on community need, safety, and utilisation, and develop a coordinated rebuild program with clear timelines and budgets.

activities.title: Incorporate community input into infrastructure design
activities.description: Engage communities in the design and planning of rebuilt infrastructure to ensure facilities meet current and future needs, incorporate lessons learned, and reflect community aspirations.

activities.title: Apply betterment principles in rebuilding
activities.description: Where possible, rebuild community infrastructure to improved standards that enhance functionality, resilience, accessibility, and environmental sustainability beyond pre-disaster condition.

activities.title: Coordinate temporary facility arrangements
activities.description: Provide temporary community facilities including demountable buildings, shared spaces, and pop-up services to maintain community access to services during the rebuild period.

indicators.title: Community infrastructure rebuild completion rate
indicators.description: Percentage of damaged community infrastructure projects completed against the approved rebuild program, tracked by facility type, value, and location.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Infrastructure project management system tracking all community infrastructure rebuild projects from approval through to completion, reported monthly.

indicators.title: Facility utilisation and community satisfaction
indicators.description: Utilisation levels and community satisfaction with rebuilt community facilities, measuring whether new facilities are meeting community needs and expectations.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Facility utilisation data from facility managers combined with community satisfaction surveys conducted within 6 months of each facility reopening.

indicators.title: Betterment and improvement outcomes achieved
indicators.description: Proportion of rebuilt community infrastructure that incorporates betterment improvements beyond pre-disaster condition, including resilience, accessibility, and functionality upgrades.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Post-completion assessment of rebuilt facilities against pre-disaster specifications and betterment criteria, documented in project completion reports.

outcomes.title: Private residential infrastructure repaired and rebuilt
outcomes.description: Disaster-damaged private residential properties have been repaired, rebuilt, or replaced, enabling residents to return to safe, habitable, and appropriate housing that meets current building standards.

activities.title: Coordinate residential repair and rebuild support
activities.description: Establish coordinated support services for homeowners undertaking repairs and rebuilds, including builder referral services, quality assurance, and dispute resolution mechanisms.

activities.title: Streamline building approval and compliance processes
activities.description: Implement fast-tracked building approval processes for disaster repairs and rebuilds while maintaining appropriate safety and quality standards, including dedicated assessment teams and simplified application requirements.

activities.title: Provide financial assistance for residential rebuilding
activities.description: Administer grants, concessional loans, and other financial support to assist homeowners who lack sufficient insurance or resources to repair or rebuild their damaged homes.

activities.title: Manage builder and trade workforce supply
activities.description: Coordinate workforce supply strategies to ensure adequate builders and tradespeople are available in disaster-affected areas, including licensing support, accommodation provision, and skills recognition programs.

indicators.title: Residential property repair and rebuild completion rates
indicators.description: Percentage of disaster-damaged residential properties that have been repaired or rebuilt to habitable standard, tracked by damage level, location, and tenure type.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Building permit data from local government combined with damage assessment records, analysed monthly to track repair progress against total damaged properties.

indicators.title: Building approval processing timeliness
indicators.description: Average time taken to process building applications for disaster-related residential repairs and rebuilds compared to standard processing times and community expectations.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Local government building approval system data on application lodgement, assessment, and determination dates, analysed monthly with median and 90th percentile reporting.

indicators.title: Homeowner satisfaction with rebuild process and outcomes
indicators.description: Homeowner satisfaction with the residential rebuild experience including quality of construction, timeliness, cost management, and adequacy of support received.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Post-completion homeowner satisfaction survey administered within 3 months of rebuild completion, covering build quality, process experience, and support adequacy.

indicators.title: Building workforce availability and capacity
indicators.description: Assessment of the availability and capacity of builders and tradespeople working on residential repairs in the disaster-affected area relative to demand.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Workforce supply monitoring through builder registration data, building commencement records, and industry consultation conducted monthly during peak rebuild period.

outcomes.title: Private commercial and rural infrastructure rebuilt
outcomes.description: Disaster-damaged commercial buildings, industrial facilities, and rural property infrastructure including fencing, sheds, water systems, and farm buildings have been repaired or replaced to restore economic productivity.

activities.title: Provide commercial and rural property rebuild assistance
activities.description: Deliver financial and technical assistance to commercial property owners and primary producers to support repair and rebuilding of business premises and farm infrastructure.

activities.title: Coordinate rural infrastructure restoration programs
activities.description: Establish coordinated programs to assist with large-scale rural infrastructure restoration including fencing, water systems, and livestock handling facilities, leveraging volunteer labour and community support.

activities.title: Support building back better for commercial and rural properties
activities.description: Provide technical guidance and incentives for commercial and rural property owners to rebuild to improved resilience standards, incorporating hazard-appropriate design and materials.

indicators.title: Commercial property rebuild progress
indicators.description: Percentage of damaged commercial and industrial buildings that have been repaired or rebuilt to operational standard, by building type and severity of damage.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Building permit and occupancy data from local government, combined with commercial property condition assessments, tracked monthly.

indicators.title: Rural infrastructure restoration progress
indicators.description: Proportion of disaster-damaged rural infrastructure including fencing, water systems, and farm buildings that has been repaired or replaced.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Rural property infrastructure recovery survey administered at 6-monthly intervals to affected primary producers, covering all major infrastructure categories.

indicators.title: Improved building standards adoption in rebuilds
indicators.description: Proportion of rebuilt commercial and rural properties that have incorporated improved resilience features, better materials, or enhanced design standards compared to pre-disaster construction.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Building certification data review comparing rebuilt property specifications against pre-disaster standards, conducted as properties reach completion.

outcomes.title: Infrastructure resilience enhanced for future events
outcomes.description: Infrastructure in the disaster-affected area has been rebuilt or retrofitted to enhanced resilience standards, reducing vulnerability to future hazard events and improving the community's ability to withstand and recover from future disasters.

activities.title: Implement infrastructure resilience standards in rebuilding
activities.description: Apply updated building codes, design standards, and hazard-appropriate construction specifications to all infrastructure rebuilding, ensuring improved performance in future disaster events.

activities.title: Undertake land use and hazard risk assessment reviews
activities.description: Review and update land use planning instruments, hazard mapping, and development controls to incorporate lessons learned and reduce future infrastructure exposure to natural hazards.

activities.title: Invest in protective infrastructure and mitigation works
activities.description: Design and construct infrastructure mitigation works such as levees, firebreaks, retaining walls, and drainage upgrades to protect rebuilt infrastructure from future hazard impacts.

activities.title: Retrofit existing infrastructure for improved resilience
activities.description: Identify and fund retrofitting programs for existing infrastructure that was not damaged but has been identified as vulnerable to future disaster impacts, improving overall community resilience.

indicators.title: Infrastructure rebuilt to enhanced resilience standards
indicators.description: Proportion of rebuilt infrastructure that meets or exceeds updated resilience standards and hazard-appropriate design specifications.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Building compliance data from certification authorities, documenting resilience standard adoption in all rebuilt infrastructure, reviewed annually.

indicators.title: Updated planning and building controls implemented
indicators.description: Status of land use planning amendments, building code updates, and development control changes that incorporate disaster lessons and improve future infrastructure resilience.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Planning instrument review tracking the progress of identified planning and building control amendments from initiation through to gazettal and implementation.

indicators.title: Mitigation infrastructure projects completed
indicators.description: Number and value of infrastructure mitigation projects completed or underway that provide protective benefits to the disaster-affected community.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Mitigation project register maintained by responsible agencies, tracking project status, cost, completion dates, and estimated risk reduction benefits.

indicators.title: Modelled risk reduction from infrastructure improvements
indicators.description: Estimated reduction in community risk exposure resulting from infrastructure resilience improvements, measured through updated hazard risk modelling and damage assessments.
indicators.data_collection_methodology: Hazard risk modelling incorporating post-rebuild infrastructure data, conducted at 12-monthly intervals to estimate residual risk and risk reduction achieved.
